title: Personal Knowledge Feedback Loop + Capability Utilization Closure
rationale:
PRISM has a strong vault layer (Karpathy LLM-Wiki at knowledge/wiki/, 722 entries) and a partial recall layer (memory-rag-inject, wiki-precheck-inject), but is largely missing the personal-content capture layer that closes cyrilXBT's feedback loop. Article framing: 'A second brain that never talks back is not a second brain. It is a very organized way to forget things.' This milestone closes 6 named gaps from `[[reference_cyrilxbt_obsidian_article_delta_2026-05-07]]`.

[EXTENDED 2026-05-07] After 10-agent H:/ drive utilization audit (overall score 41.5/100), 7 additional units added across S4-S6 to close the meta-finding: PRISM has capability OVERPRODUCTION + exposure UNDERPRODUCTION. Per cyrilXBT framing, this is the same failure mode ("organized way to forget things") at the capability layer. Quick wins (schema backfill, PDF scan extension, hook stub cleanup) plus strategic closures (skill auto-invoke triggers, resources scheduled ingestion, mistakes auto-wire, tribal consolidate). See [[reference_h_drive_utilization_audit_2026-05-07]] for the per-agent breakdown.

four_loop.tie_up: Cite Agent 5 finding; verify mistakes/ subdir auto-created on first postmortem (memory-mirror routing handles this).

abort_criteria: False-positive rate >5% (creates postmortems on benign stops)
Hook adds >200ms to Stop event (latency regression)
Postmortem file size >50KB (verbosity regression)

exit_criteria: Test: 3 stops in 5min with uncommitted state writes exactly 1 postmortem to memories/mistakes/
Test: 1 stop with uncommitted state writes 0 postmortems
Test: Postmortem markdown contains: error-signature-hash, files-touched, last-3-commits, suggested-fix sections

metrics.trigger_condition: at least 3 Stop events in 5min OR uncommitted-restart-after-failure pattern
metrics.postmortem_format: Markdown with named sections: Context, Failure, Root Cause, Detection, Fix, Prevention

units.title: Weekly cron promoting high-confidence tribal tips to memories/reference/
units.build_description: Knowledge Vault Coverage (Agent 5) found 4,245 tribal tips ingested in 10 days but <5% queried. Tips are write-only. Add weekly cron that calls TribalKnowledgeEngine to identify tips with: (a) cited by >=2 sources, (b) accessed >=3 times in last month (or any access if no telemetry), (c) not yet promoted. For each, write a synthesis to memories/reference/tribal-<topic>-<date>.md. /weekly-synthesis will then surface these as part of normal vault synthesis.

four_loop.build: Script: query tribal engine for high-confidence tips; group by topic; synthesize via Ollama; write to memories/reference/tribal-<topic>-YYYY-WW.md with frontmatter linking to source tips.
four_loop.scrutinize: /scrutinize for synthesis quality (target: each promoted tip has >=1 specific physical claim with citation).
four_loop.gap_fill: Tests: empty tribal corpus (no writes), single high-confidence tip (no synthesis, just promotion), 50+ tips on one topic (synthesizes to <=2KB summary), already-promoted topic (skip vs update).
four_loop.tie_up: First-run report: how many tips qualified, how many topics emerged, how many memories written.

abort_criteria: Synthesis quality <70% (vague summaries with no citations)
Cron writes >100 reference memories in single week (over-promotion)
TribalKnowledgeEngine API changes mid-script and breaks query
rollback.rollback_procedure: rm script + test && git checkout HEAD -- mcp-server/data/state/cron-jobs.json

exit_criteria: Test: synthetic 50-tip corpus on one topic synthesizes to <=2KB markdown with >=3 citations
Test: re-run within 1 week skips already-promoted topics (idempotent)
Live first-run: produces >=5 reference memories with citation count >=1 each

metrics.aggregate_confidence_floor: promoted memory carries mean(source_tip_confidence) at least 0.6
metrics.cadence: weekly cron (Monday 04:13 local), idempotent (1-week dedup window)

criteria: memories/mistakes/ subdir non-empty after first failure-restart in test scenario
memories/reference/tribal-* entries created weekly
Both visible in /weekly-synthesis output
